report.explanation: Operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors is unverified and contradicted by current telemetry. Traces show all checkout, order, payment, inventory and postgres spans returning 200/ok. Metrics show order v1.0.0 serving /v1/orders 200 with zero 502s; v2.0.0 shows no traffic. Deployment record only proves version facts. No evidence establishes a bounded cause; hand off.
missing_evidence: Error logs or traces showing actual checkout failures (logs-order excluded from context)
Metrics confirming nonzero error status codes on checkout/order routes
Deployment timeline correlating version change with any error onset
Evidence of resource saturation (db pool, redis, memory) on affected service
